activity.notes: Appointed ambassador to Franco Spain on 2 March 1939; remained until recalled to join Reynaud cabinet on 18 May 1940. May 1940 end is source-level month granularity without an invented exact termination day; concurrent transition to Deputy PM on 18 May. Activity domain emphasis: governance.

sources.title: Michel Catala (1997), L'ambassade espagnole de Pétain (mars 1939–mai 1940), Vingtième Siècle
sources.citation_text: Archival historical scholarship dates Pétain's Madrid ambassador appointment to 2 March 1939; position ended upon recall to Reynaud government May 1940.
